necessary_contract: C binds its originally owned fresh fixture parent.
R creates an exclusive fresh private child and mounts its 1MiB tmpfs there.
R closes every setup/ancestor handle before GO and retires setup capability.
Namespace teardown releases mounts, not a new privileged unmount operation.
C deletes only originally owned objects; replaced or foreign paths must be retained.
gap: The private child's host-filesystem backing directory is a different object from C's pre-bound parent. The frozen protocol does not retain its original identity in C. A late same-owner/mode/name stat cannot distinguish that object from a replacement, while mount namespace destruction does not unlink the backing directory.

existing_interface.binding: lifecycle._FixtureBinding(mode, uid, gid, deadline, device, inode, owner) binds the original parent.
existing_interface.R_before: Fixed _decode_frame fields: identity binding, owned child pid, kind/stage/status/error, result, setup_status.
existing_interface.R_after: Fixed before reference, cleanup, disposition, status; no filesystem object identity slot.
existing_interface.worker: Six-element null mount states, at most one operation, caps/denials/IO/FD/topology semantic data; no backing-object field.
existing_interface.C_run: Outcome mode forbids producer_channel/producer_handler and input_data, forwards no setup FDs, and has no admitted observation callback.

benign_actual_API_evidence.positive: Existing c8 R-before and original parent binding decode normally.
negative: Adding fixture_child or backing_identity to an R frame rejects with outcome fields.
Substituting the child's inode for the original parent rejects with outcome fixture mismatch.
Adding an eighth child-identity argument to _FixtureBinding rejects with TypeError.
benign_actual_API_evidence.operations: Only actual c8 serialization/type checks, with process/prctl/signal helpers trapped; no payload/watchdog/syscall namespace or helper execution.

preparation_disposition.execution_contract: Unconditional finite refusal; no environment or argument override.
preparation_disposition.coordinator: Preserves the scope allocation, verifies source, emits bounded no-launch/unavailable records and returns125 without a budget, fixture or sudo acquisition.
preparation_disposition.reaper_entry: Same independent unconditional refusal before any root-role operation.
preparation_disposition.safe_cleanup: The implemented pure/mock-tested guard may remove only an empty original parent. Any child is retained because its original identity is unavailable.
preparation_disposition.implemented_but_not_connected: Fixed R/N/W role functions and the actual c8 run_capture adapter are prepared and mocked. Final live C fixture/launch/cleanup orchestration is not connected under the hold.

not_done: No c8 API or frame-schema edit.
No overloaded mode/binding field or fabricated child inode.
No new receipt file, transport, broker, privileged unmount or cleanup command.
No actual namespace, helper, privileged workload, push, workflow, merge or overall completion.
No revised technical contract or execution allocation inferred from this finding.
next_owner: Main independently reviews the exact preparation and this contract contradiction. Any changed ownership contract and actual one-shot launch require a separate explicit freeze.
